source: A2 epic, 'The launch languages, 26 of them' (Linear P-CUR-15). Belebele codes checked against the facebook/belebele config names and the lm-evaluation-harness belebele task list.

languages.name: English
languages.notes: Baseline for the shared tasks. English raters rate English answers to the same tasks.

languages.name: Spanish (Latin America)
languages.notes: Latin American Spanish. Spanish from Spain is its own entry (spa-ES), with its own requests and answers.

languages.name: Spanish (Spain)
languages.notes: Spanish from Spain, with its own requests and answers. Belebele has one Spanish (spa_Latn), shared with spa.

languages.name: Portuguese (Brazil)
languages.notes: Brazilian Portuguese. European Portuguese is its own entry (por-PT), with its own requests and answers, because vocabulary, forms of address and spelling differ.

languages.name: Portuguese (Portugal)
languages.notes: European Portuguese, with its own requests and answers. Belebele has one Portuguese (por_Latn), shared with por.

languages.name: French
languages.notes: tu or vous is part of the task: formal tasks expect vous.

languages.name: German
languages.notes: du or Sie is part of the task: formal tasks expect Sie.

languages.name: Ukrainian
languages.notes: Answers drifting into Russian are a known failure shape and count as not in the language.

languages.name: Romanian
languages.notes: Missing diacritics (s instead of ș, t instead of ț) is a common model failure and counts under language quality.

languages.name: Arabic
languages.notes: Belebele and the tasks use Modern Standard Arabic. Dialect answers are not measured in v1. Belebele also has five dialect configs (acm, apc, ars, ary, arz) if this is ever needed.

languages.name: Hindi
languages.notes: Many people type Hindi in Latin script. Belebele has hin_Latn. v1 measures Devanagari only.

languages.name: Bengali
languages.notes: Belebele also has ben_Latn. v1 measures Bengali script only.

languages.name: Urdu
languages.notes: Belebele also has urd_Latn. Rendering in Nastaliq versus Naskh fonts affects readability, not correctness. The A2 epic lists Urdu among the languages Global MMLU misses.

languages.name: Vietnamese
languages.notes: Missing tone diacritics make text hard to read and count under language quality.

languages.name: Tagalog
languages.notes: Tagalog and not Filipino, because that is the name the models and the benchmarks use (A2 epic). Everyday Tagalog mixes English (Taglish). Raters judge whether the mix is natural, not whether English words appear.

languages.name: Mandarin
languages.notes: Simplified script only. Belebele also has zho_Hant. An answer in Traditional script is rated as a language issue in v1.

languages.name: Pashto
languages.notes: Belebele has Southern Pashto (pbt). Raters from other varieties declare it. Eastern Arabic digits are acceptable.

languages.name: Kiswahili
languages.notes: Kenyan and Tanzanian usage differ in vocabulary. Raters declare their variety.

languages.name: Yoruba
languages.notes: Tone marks and underdots are often dropped by models and by people typing. Raters judge readability, and missing marks count under language quality only when they change meaning or make the text hard to read.

languages.name: Hausa
languages.notes: Boko (Latin) script. Hooked letters (ɓ ɗ ƙ) are often replaced by b d k. Ajami script is not measured.
